reason: A free pilot sounds harmless, but after it we would be paying close to 5,000 euros a year on top of our current vendor, and that has to go through the next budget round with a clear return. I won't put the board's time into a pilot for something I can't budget for yet.
objection: This is an extra cost next to what we already pay, not instead of it, unless we fully switch, and I don't see the savings that would pay for it. Two founders and not one club live yet also makes me nervous about who is still there in three years.
would_change_my_mind: A side-by-side showing it replaces our current system so our total software bill stays the same or drops, plus a call with Golfclub Zwolle's board once they have been live for a while.
